import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

airports = data['airports']['data']

region_colors = {
    'North America': '#2563EB',
    'Europe': '#059669',
    'Asia-Pacific': '#D97706',
    'Middle East': '#DC2626',
    'Latin America': '#7C3AED',
    'Africa': '#0891B2',
}

regions_order = ['North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Middle East', 'Latin America', 'Africa']

highlight_airports = {'Atlanta (ATL)', 'Dubai (DXB)', 'Tokyo Haneda (HND)'}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 9))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFBFC')
ax.set_facecolor('#FAFBFC')

min_routes = min(a['routes'] for a in airports)
max_routes = max(a['routes'] for a in airports)

def scale_size(routes):
    min_s, max_s = 80, 900
    return min_s + (routes - min_routes) / (max_routes - min_routes) * (max_s - min_s)

for region in regions_order:
    subset = [a for a in airports if a['region'] == region]
    x = [a['throughput_million'] for a in subset]
    y = [a['on_time_rate'] for a in subset]
    s = [scale_size(a['routes']) for a in subset]
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s, c=region_colors[region], alpha=0.65,
               edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8, label=region, zorder=3)

for a in airports:
    if a['airport'] in highlight_airports:
        x, y = a['throughput_million'], a['on_time_rate']
        s = scale_size(a['routes'])
        ax.scatter([x], [y], s=[s], c=region_colors[a['region']], alpha=0.85,
                   edgecolors='#1F2937', linewidths=2.0, zorder=5)

offsets = {
    'Atlanta (ATL)': (-2, -4.5),
    'Dubai (DXB)': (2.5, 2.5),
    'Tokyo Haneda (HND)': (3, -1.5),
}

for a in airports:
    if a['airport'] in highlight_airports:
        x, y = a['throughput_million'], a['on_time_rate']
        dx, dy = offsets[a['airport']]
        ax.annotate(
            a['airport'],
            xy=(x, y), xytext=(x + dx, y + dy),
            fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1F2937',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#6B7280', lw=1.2,
                            connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15'),
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white',
                      edgecolor='#D1D5DB', alpha=0.9),
            zorder=6,
        )

ax.set_xlabel('Annual Passenger Throughput (millions)', fontsize=12, fontweight='medium',
              color='#374151', labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('On-Time Performance (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='medium',
              color='#374151', labelpad=10)
ax.set_title('Airport Throughput vs. Punctuality\nBubble size = number of routes served',

ax.set_ylim(67, 94)

ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(5))

ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#D1D5DB')

legend = ax.legend(
    loc='lower right', fontsize=10, frameon=True,
    fancybox=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#D1D5DB',
    title='Region', title_fontsize=11,
    markerscale=0.6, scatterpoints=1,
)
legend.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

size_legend_routes = [100, 200, 350]
size_legend_labels = ['100', '200', '350']
for i, (routes, label) in enumerate(zip(size_legend_routes, size_legend_labels)):
    s = scale_size(routes)
    ax.scatter([], [], s=s, c='#9CA3AF', alpha=0.5, edgecolors='white',

handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()

size_handles = handles[len(regions_order):]
size_labels = labels[len(regions_order):]

from matplotlib.legend_handler import HandlerTuple

                 fancybox=True, framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='#D1D5DB',
                 title='Region', title_fontsize=10,
                 markerscale=0.55, scatterpoints=1,
                 bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.0))

                 title='Route Network', title_fontsize=10,
                 markerscale=1.0, scatterpoints=1,
                 bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.27))

fig.text(0.99, 0.01, 'Source: Global Airport Performance Dataset  |  30 Major International Airports',
         ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color='#9CA3AF', style='italic')

    min_s, max_s = 80, 900
    return min_s + (routes - min_routes) / (max_routes - min_routes) * (max_s - min_s)

for region in regions_order:

    x = [a['throughput_million'] for a in subset]
    y = [a['on_time_rate'] for a in subset]
    s = [scale_size(a['routes']) for a in subset]
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s, c=region_colors[region], alpha=0.65,
               edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8, label=region, zorder=3)

for a in airports:
    if a['airport'] in highlight_airports:
        x, y = a['throughput_million'], a['on_time_rate']
        s = scale_size(a['routes'])
        ax.scatter([x], [y], s=[s], c=region_colors[a['region']], alpha=0.85,
                   edgecolors='#1F2937', linewidths=2.0, zorder=5)

offsets = {

}

for a in airports:

        dx, dy = offsets[a['airport']]
        ax.annotate(

ax.set_xlabel('Annual Passenger Throughput (millions)', fontsize=12, fontweight='medium',
              color='#374151', labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('On-Time Performance (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='medium',
              color='#374151', labelpad=10)
ax.set_title('Airport Throughput vs. Punctuality\nBubble size = number of routes served',
             fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', color='#111827', pad=18)

ax.set_xlim(5, 100)
ax.set_ylim(67, 94)
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(10))
ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(5))
ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=10, colors='#4B5563')

ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4, color='#9CA3AF', zorder=1)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_color('#D1D5DB')
ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#D1D5DB')

legend = ax.legend(
    loc='lower right', fontsize=10, frameon=True,
    fancybox=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#D1D5DB',
    title='Region', title_fontsize=11,
    markerscale=0.6, scatterpoints=1,
)
legend.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

size_legend_routes = [100, 200, 350]
size_legend_labels = ['100', '200', '350']
for i, (routes, label) in enumerate(zip(size_legend_routes, size_legend_labels)):
    s = scale_size(routes)
    ax.scatter([], [], s=s, c='#9CA3AF', alpha=0.5, edgecolors='white',
               linewidths=0.6, label=f'{label} routes')

handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
region_handles = handles[:len(regions_order)]
region_labels = labels[:len(regions_order)]
size_handles = handles[len(regions_order):]
size_labels = labels[len(regions_order):]

from matplotlib.legend_handler import HandlerTuple

                 title='Region', title_fontsize=10,
                 markerscale=0.55, scatterpoints=1,
                 bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.0))
leg1.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

leg2 = ax.legend(size_handles, size_labels,
                 loc='lower right', fontsize=9.5, frameon=True,
                 fancybox=True, framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='#D1D5DB',
                 title='Route Network', title_fontsize=10,
                 markerscale=1.0, scatterpoints=1,
                 bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.27))
leg2.get_title().set_fontweight('bold')

ax.add_artist(leg1)

fig.text(0.99, 0.01, 'Source: Global Airport Performance Dataset  |  30 Major International Airports',
